data.name: Jute Pest
data.abstract:
This dataset has 17 classes. Data are divided in three partition train, val and test. The classes are 
0 : Beet Armyworm
1 : Black Hairy
2 : Cutworm
3 : Field Cricket
4 : Jute Aphid
5 : Jute Hairy
6 : Jute Red Mite
7 : Jute Semilooper
8 : Jute Stem Girdler
9 : Jute Stem Weevil
10 : Leaf Beetle
11 : Mealybug
12 : Pod Borer
13 : Scopula Emissaria
14 : Termite
15 : Termite odontotermes (Rambur)
16 : Yellow Mite

intro_paper.title: An Efficient Deep Learning Approach for Jute Pest Classification Using Transfer Learning
intro_paper.authors: Muhammad Tanvirul Islam and Md. Sadekur Rahman
intro_paper.venue: 2024 6th International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Information & Communication Technology (ICEEICT)
